extDescription.message: Read a page and its translation side by side, in the same tab.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and on chrome://extensions

error_unsupported_page.message: parallax cannot run on $SCHEME$ pages — Chrome blocks extensions there.

error_injection_failed.message: parallax could not start on this tab: $REASON$

reason.example: Cannot access contents of the page

error_window_too_small.message: The window is too narrow to split. It needs at least $REQUIRED$ px.

error_translator_api_missing.message: Chrome's built-in Translator API is not available. parallax needs Chrome 138 or later on desktop; it does not work on Android or iOS.

error_translation_unavailable.message: Chrome cannot translate $SOURCE$ to $TARGET$ on this device.

error_low_confidence.message: Could not determine this page's language. Pick a source language in the popup.

error_activation_required.message: Chrome needs a click here before it can download the language pack.

error_download_failed.message: The language pack could not be downloaded: $REASON$

error_frame_blocked.message: This site refuses to be embedded (X-Frame-Options: DENY, or a Content-Security-Policy of frame-ancestors 'none'), so it cannot be shown in a split view. Open the parallax toolbar icon to allow it for this site.

error_frame_blocked_by.message: This site refuses to be embedded ($HEADER$), so it cannot be shown in a split view. Open the parallax toolbar icon to allow it for this site.

error_frame_load_timeout.message: The page did not finish loading in the split view within $SECONDS$ seconds.

error_frame_busted.message: This site navigates away when it is embedded, so it cannot be shown in a split view.

error_framing_unsafe.message: parallax will not override this site's framing rules: its Content-Security-Policy uses a per-response $REASON$, and rewriting the policy would stop the page's own scripts from running.

error_no_anchors.message: Scroll sync is unavailable: this page has no block-level anchors to align on.
